scope: Documentary feasibility and selected design consistency only; no real provider, runtime, billing, merchant or production qualification.

exclusions: Managed model APIs and paid tools
Additional environments, email, monitoring, alerting and support
Thirty-five-day daily recovery storage beyond included example; actual changed/snapshot bytes need measurement
Extra database replicas/branches/private transfer; runtime snapshots/images and other provider meters not modeled
Enterprise SSO/DirectorySync/contracts, provider quota funding requirements, taxes and any enterprise commitments
assumptions: 100 merchants, twenty total active VM hours each; 2vCPU/4GiB; five retained 8GiB disks each; thirty-day/720-hour month
Neon average1CU;50GB database and50GB billable restore history; no replicas
5GB R2 per merchant; API/workflow CPU and operation counts are illustrative aggregate inputs, not measured
Ordinary included usage applied; no trial/startup credits or Daytona disk discount assumed
Queue input is billable operations, not message count; transitions/waiting in started VM count as reserved running time
